text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Preparing for the upcoming Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby),
the days of rigorous training continuedâ

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, whew...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, sir!
Guhhh!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...*cough*, *cough*, *wheeze*!
*pant*, *gasp*, *pant*!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Alright!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*! Th-that's rough...!
My legs are shaking...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Shall we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...No! If it's getting tough,
that just means now's the time to push harder!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Indeed.
The Nippon Derby is coming up soon, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: T... Target time cleared!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Body weight and muscle mass are right on schedule according to Trainer's plan!
Just as expected, everything's perfect! With this—
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's head into the Japanese Derby with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the day of the Japanese Derby arrived.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (I-I'm so restless!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(There really are a lot of people. It is a once-in-a-lifetime
grand stage to determine the pinnacle of our generation, after all...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Wah... This tension is bringing back
memories of my first ballet recital.
I was fidgeting right up until the very moment...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...I told Trainer it'd be fine to meet up here,
but maybe I should've just come along with them.)

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, isn't that Orfevre!?
W-Whoa, this is insane!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see her interview?
She sounded completely unstoppable—
saying the only thing she worries about is the state of the turf."

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but it makes sense...
Especially judging by how she ran in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...Orfe-san was in top form. Seriously top form.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, HAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
…………
She's so, so much better than when I saw her last time...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't stand... watching any more of it.
So I went back to the dorm—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(............
Can I really surpass them?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Everything I've done.
Both the target times, and the body I built.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (If none of it meant anything—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Losing confidence again...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(No... it's okay, it'll be fine.
As long as I put it out properly, it'll be fine—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was putting together the final race plan based on the current condition of the runners, the track state, and other factors.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our plan is set, and now
all that's left is to wait for Win Variation to arrive, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Oh, good work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I immediately showed and explained the plan I'd put together.
I went into detail about ideal positioning from the start,
which rivals to mark, and so on.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer really is so dependable...
choice_data_list: W-What's wrong, all of a sudden?
W-What's gotten into you all of a sudden

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Um, to be honest, I'm feeling a bit anxious. I guess it's because it's the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, looking at this...
I'm starting to feel a lot more relaxed!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...My hesitation is gone. I'm okay now.
Thank you, Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. All right, I got this!
Time to get fired up again!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I'll work hard, win, and steal the spotlight!
I'll do it, just you watch...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Raising high the banner to defeat Orfevre—
the Japanese Derby has begun!"
